title: The lower root-line pullback path on a pure tensor
statement: Fix l,E,X,Y,f and Geometry g with its actual finite unit-transition normalization [def-sp-tower-shriek-data] and Chern data cY [def-sp-tower-class-chern]. Fix n<=m. Suppose a level-n morphism delta from inverse image of finiteLine(Y,n) to finiteLine(X,n) has the normalized finite-adjunct unit-tensor formula using restrictRoot [def-sp-tower-class-pullback]. Precompose the transition of g.pull(lineModule(cY)) by inverse level-m pull evaluation and inverse lineEvaluation. Postcompose by restriction of level-n pull evaluation, inverse image of level-n lineEvaluation and delta. The level-m adjunct of this lower path sends the unit tensor of z to the level-n unit tensor on the pulled-back chart of the X roots transition of restrictRoot(m,z). This uses no cX and no level-m comparison delta.

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension of the roots tower; horizontal transition calculation of lem-sfb-tower-class-line-pullback-existence

proof.text: Naturality of the actual finite adjunctions moves the source line evaluation and target comparison out of the transpose. Apply Geometry.ordinaryUnitTransition: this is exactly naturality of the actual finite inverse-image units with horizontal restrictions, before any line object is considered.

Use lineEvaluation_transition_tensor to choose the native level-n inverse tensor generator as the section in Geometry.ordinaryUnitTransition. Naturality of the finite adjunction moves the line evaluation through the transpose; its inverse cancels on that generator. Substitute the given single-level unit-tensor normalization of delta.

The actual roots direct-image maps form a natural transformation by their power formula. Naturality at n<=m gives root compatibility, including m=n and empty charts. No general coefficient-transition equation is needed: all tensor coefficients are one.

proof_origin.place: classes (2), scalar extension and horizontal naturality of the roots tower

theorem linePullback_lower_tensor
    {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E} {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f) (cY : Chern l E Y)
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (δ : (proEtaleConstantRingPullback (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).obj
      (finiteLine l E Y n) ⟶ finiteLine l E X n)
    (hδ : ∀ (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (z : (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf Y (l ^ (n + 1))).obj.obj U),
      (((proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).homEquiv _ _)
        δ).val.app U
          (Scheme.tateFiniteTensor Y l (FiniteRing l E n) n (finiteScalar l E n)
            U.unop 1 z) =
        Scheme.tateFiniteTensor X l (FiniteRing l E n) n (finiteScalar l E n)
          (chart f U).unop
          1
          (restrictRoot l f n U z))
    (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (z : (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf Y (l ^ (m + 1))).obj.obj U) :
    (((proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (SpTowerShriek.R l E m) f).homEquiv _ _)
      ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback (SpTowerShriek.R l E m) f).map
          (lineEvaluation l E cY m).inv ≫
        (g.ordinaryPullEvaluation m).inv.app (lineModule l E cY) ≫
        (SemilinearSections.transition.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (SpTowerShriek.B l E X)
          (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h).app (g.pull.obj (lineModule l E cY)) ≫
        (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (SemilinearSections.coefficientMap.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (SpTowerShriek.B l E X)
            (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h)).map
          ((g.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).hom.app (lineModule l E cY) ≫
            (proEtaleConstantRingPullback (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).map
              (lineEvaluation l E cY n).hom ≫ δ))).val.app U
      (Scheme.tateFiniteTensor Y l (FiniteRing l E m) m (finiteScalar l E m)
        U.unop 1 z) =
      Scheme.tateFiniteTensor X l (FiniteRing l E n) n (finiteScalar l E n)
        (chart f U).unop
        1
        (((roots l X).map (homOfLE h).op).hom.app (chart f U)
          (restrictRoot l f m U z))
